row:
This channel serves to inform our viewers about animal health related topics. We can show you simple things like how to cut a pet's nails, clean the ears, or how to brush his
 teeth.  We also show how we clean a pet's teeth or some surgeries like the removal of a bladder stone. We will show you the new evolving field of animal physiotherapy and many other topics. We will be adding new videos, so come back and check once in a while!
